pack.title: Rainbow Hunt
pack.tagline: Find nature in every color of the rainbow.
pack.summary: Walk together and collect six nature photos that build a rainbow from red to purple.

bonus_rules: Complete all six colors for a rainbow bonus.
Get a bonus if four or more colors come from living things.
rules.safety_note: Stay on public paths and sidewalks. Do not enter yards or private gardens.
rules.weather_note: This challenge works in sun, fog, or light cloud because color is the core mechanic.

cards.title: Find red
cards.prompt: Take a photo of something red in nature.
cards.adult_prompt: Look for flowers, berries, leaves, bark, seed pods, or insects.

cards.title: Find orange
cards.prompt: Take a photo of something orange in nature.
cards.adult_prompt: Look for petals, rust-colored leaves, bark, or tiny fungi.

cards.title: Find yellow
cards.prompt: Take a photo of something yellow in nature.
cards.adult_prompt: Flowers and lichen are especially strong yellow targets.

cards.title: Find green
cards.prompt: Take a photo of something green in nature.
cards.adult_prompt: This can be moss, leaves, grass, bark growth, or algae-like texture.

cards.title: Find blue
cards.prompt: Take a photo of something blue in nature.
cards.adult_prompt: Blue is hard. Look carefully for petals, berries, sky reflected in water, or blue-green plant tones.

cards.title: Find purple
cards.prompt: Take a photo of something purple in nature.
cards.adult_prompt: Flowers are the easiest target, but shadows and foliage sometimes work too.

recap.title: Your rainbow recap
recap.success_message: You found a full rainbow in nature.
recap.partial_message: You found part of the rainbow. Next walk can finish it.
recap.empty_message: No colors were saved this time.
highlight_rules: Show one best photo per color.
Call out whether the parent or kid found each color first.
